@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。本單元請抽查：照片邊緣或反光處，個別字詞可能有誤。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It was n______e of you to return that bag full of money to the police station.
= noble
~詞義 noble（adj.）崇高的;高尚的
~原文 It was noble of you to return that bag full of money to the police station.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The villagers f______d to higher ground when they realized the river was rising dangerously fast.
= fled
~詞義 flee（v.）逃走;逃跑
~原文 The villagers fled to higher ground when they realized the river was rising dangerously fast.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: During the French Revolution, the king of France was o______wn by his people.
= overthrown
~詞義 overthrow（v.）推翻
~原文 During the French Revolution, the king of France was overthrown by his people.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: You should organize your thoughts before you start to act because the problem needs to be solved in a s______c way.
= systematic
~詞義 systematic（adj.）有系統的;有條理的
~原文 You should organize your thoughts before you start to act because the problem needs to be solved in a systematic way.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The doctor t______ed herself for many years with the thought that she could have saved the life of that patient.
= tortured
~詞義 torture（v.）折磨
~原文 The doctor tortured herself for many years with the thought that she could have saved the life of that patient.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The family possesses ______ supplies to live through one harsh winter.
A: gracious
B: memorable
C: coarse
D: adequate
= D
~詞義 adequate（adj.）足夠的
~原文 The family possesses adequate supplies to live through one harsh winter.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ between the two groups resulted in the loss of many people's lives.
A: clash
B: paw
C: glimpse
D: spark
= A
~詞義 clash（n.）衝突
~原文 The clash between the two groups resulted in the loss of many people's lives.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: After the fight, the winning knight let his opponent leave with his ______, and this kind act won him great respect.
A: argument
B: nonsense
C: evaluation
D: dignity
= D
~詞義 dignity（n.）尊嚴
~原文 After the fight, the winning knight let his opponent leave with his dignity, and this kind act won him great respect.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The little boy claimed that he had had only a quick ______ of the other boy's test paper.
A: battery
B: penalty
C: quarrel
D: glimpse
= D
~詞義 glimpse（n.）一瞥
~原文 The little boy claimed that he had had only a quick glimpse of the other boy's test paper.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It is nearly impossible for a kid to ______ 200 new words in one night.
A: telegraph
B: memorize
C: insert
D: evaluate
= B
~詞義 memorize（v.）記住
~原文 It is nearly impossible for a kid to memorize 200 new words in one night.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: repetition
B: bandage
C: revolution
D: embarrassment
E: fireplace
F: cliff

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before the car went over the ______, the driver jumped out of it.
= F
~詞義 cliff（n.）懸崖
~原文 Before the car went over the cliff, the driver jumped out of it.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: In winter, my grandfather likes to sit calmly by the ______, smoke a cigar, and read a book.
= E
~詞義 fireplace（n.）壁爐
~原文 In winter, my grandfather likes to sit calmly by the fireplace, smoke a cigar, and read a book.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The song's chorus relies on catchy ______, which makes it easy for listeners to remember.
= A
~詞義 repetition（n.）重複
~原文 The song's chorus relies on catchy repetition, which makes it easy for listeners to remember.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: To Betty's ______, she waved at someone who turned out to be a complete stranger.
= D
~詞義 embarrassment（n.）尷尬
~原文 To Betty's embarrassment, she waved at someone who turned out to be a complete stranger.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The Industrial ______, which led to modern civilization, was an important period in human history.
= C
~詞義 revolution（n.）革命
~原文 The Industrial revolution, which led to modern civilization, was an important period in human history.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: terror
B: relevant
C: translation

E: memorial
F: spark

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The cute baby girl laughs every time her father ______ her feet.
= D
~詞義 tickle（v.）搔癢
~原文 The cute baby girl laughs every time her father tickles her feet.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Some comments were removed because they were not ______ to the main discussion.
= B
~詞義 relevant（adj.）有關的
~原文 Some comments were removed because they were not relevant to the main discussion.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: You can start a fire by rubbing two pieces of dry wood together until you produce a ______.
= F
~詞義 spark（n.）火花
~原文 You can start a fire by rubbing two pieces of dry wood together until you produce a spark.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Most people there prefer to leave the country rather than live in ______ due to the war.
= A
~詞義 terror（n.）恐怖
~原文 Most people there prefer to leave the country rather than live in terror due to the war.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Is there a Chinese ______ of this novel? I really want to read it, but I don't understand Japanese.
= C
~詞義 translation（n.）翻譯;譯文
~原文 Is there a Chinese translation of this novel? I really want to read it, but I don't understand Japanese.
